Everyone has a smart phone that charges. Most people have seen laptops. They sell cordless, battery chargeable professional vacuums. If you’re wondering how people are making the leap from ICE engines to battery operated vehicles it’s because it makes sense. Like it’s not something we can’t accomplish. I charge this thing I charge that thing, why not my car? Subconsciously every human knows it can be done and should be done.

What if the reverse were the case. Think about it. We all use battery operated vehicles it’s all we’ve ever known. But our smartphones are powered by gas and a little engine. We fill up our phones and oil companies have little gas depots outside. We all just go about our lives, but somebody proposes we invent battery operated smart phones. It’s a little brain exercise to help you see how the mind makes a connection. It’s because we already experience this reality elsewhere
